entities.name: Sidelink UE Information Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for a UE in RRC_CONNECTED to indicate interest in NR sidelink communication, discovery, or U2N relay operation, and to request dedicated resources or report failures.

entities.name: SidelinkUEInformationNR
entities.description: RRC message transmitted by UE to indicate sidelink interests, request resources, or report configurations and failures.

entities.name: sl-RxInterestedFreqList
entities.description: IE indicating frequencies of interest for NR sidelink communication reception.

entities.name: sl-TxResourceReqList
entities.description: IE indicating required transmission resources for NR sidelink communication.

entities.name: sidelink DRX configuration
entities.description: IE reporting DRX configuration received from peer UE for NR sidelink unicast communication.

entities.name: sidelink DRX assistance information
entities.description: IE reporting DRX assistance information received from peer UE for NR sidelink unicast communication.

entities.name: Destination Layer-2 ID and QoS profile
entities.description: IE reporting service-related parameters for NR sidelink groupcast or broadcast communication with DRX.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state in which the UE must be to initiate the Sidelink UE Information procedure.

entities.name: SIB12 including sl-ConfigCommonNR provided by PCell
entities.description: Condition that SIB12 with sidelink common configuration is broadcast by the serving cell.

entities.name: Configured by upper layers
entities.description: Condition that upper layers have configured the UE for sidelink transmission or reception.

entities.name: Change since last SidelinkUEInformationNR message
entities.description: Condition that UE interests, configurations, or resources have changed since last message transmission.

entities.name: U2N Relay/Remote UE threshold conditions met
entities.description: Condition that UE meets threshold conditions for acting as U2N Relay UE or Remote UE.

relations.description: Procedure initiation requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state.
Procedure includes transmission of SidelinkUEInformationNR message.
Message may contain sidelink DRX configuration IE.
Message may contain sidelink DRX assistance information IE.
Message may contain Destination Layer-2 ID and QoS profile IE.
Procedure initiation is guarded by SIB12 being provided by PCell.
Procedure initiation is guarded by upper layer configuration for sidelink.
Message transmission is guarded by changes in UE interests or configurations.
Message transmission for relay operations is guarded by threshold conditions.
